# Data Catalog

The West Coast Node ERDDAP data server hosts over 1,700 datasets. This catalog highlights datasets commonly used by CoastWatch users. Search by name or narrow the list by product, sensor, region, and other characteristics.

Explore the [complete ERDDAP dataset listing](https://coastwatch.pfeg.noaa.gov/erddap/info/index.html?page=1&itemsPerPage=1000), or check the [Dataset Monitoring Dashboard](dataset_monitor.qmd) for dataset status.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from IPython.display import HTML, display

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Load the Pages CMS-managed YAML catalog
# ----------------------------------------------------------

catalog_path = Path("content/data_catalog.yml")

with catalog_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as file:
    catalog = yaml.safe_load(file) or {}

datasets = catalog.get("datasets", []) or []


def safe(value):
    """Escape editable text for HTML content and attributes."""
    return escape(
        str(value if value is not None else ""),
        quote=True
    )


def field(item, name):
    """Return a catalog field as a clean string."""
    return str(item.get(name) or "").strip()


def safe_url(value):
    """Accept only HTTP and HTTPS access links."""
    value = str(value or "").strip()
    parsed = urlparse(value)

    if parsed.scheme in {"http", "https"} and parsed.netloc:
        return value

    return ""


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Build dataset rows
# ----------------------------------------------------------

rows = []

for i, item in enumerate(datasets):

    title = safe(field(item, "title"))
    product = safe(field(item, "product"))
    description = safe(field(item, "description"))
    dates = safe(field(item, "dates"))
    resolution = safe(field(item, "resolution"))
    composite = safe(field(item, "composite"))

    # Values used by JavaScript filters
    attributes = {
        "product": field(item, "product"),
        "sensor": field(item, "sensor_type"),
        "region": field(item, "region"),
        "timeseries": field(item, "time_series_type"),
        "geo": field(item, "geostationary"),
        "blended": field(item, "blended"),
        "gapfilled": field(item, "gap_filled"),
        "derived": field(item, "derived_product"),
    }

    data_attrs = " ".join(
        f'data-{name}="{safe(value)}"'
        for name, value in attributes.items()
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # ERDDAP access links
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    access_links = []

    for link in item.get("access", []) or []:
        url = safe_url(link.get("url"))

        if url:
            access_links.append(
                (
                    safe(link.get("label") or "Open dataset"),
                    safe(url)
                )
            )

    if len(access_links) == 1:

        label, url = access_links[0]

        access_html = (
            f'<a class="cw-catalog-access-link" '
            f'href="{url}" '
            f'target="_blank" '
            f'rel="noopener noreferrer">'
            f'{label} ↗</a>'
        )

    elif access_links:

        options = "".join(
            f'<option value="{url}">{label}</option>'
            for label, url in access_links
        )

        access_html = (
            f'<label class="cw-catalog-sr-only" '
            f'for="access-{i}">Dataset access options</label>'
            f'<select id="access-{i}" '
            f'class="cw-catalog-access-dropdown" '
            f'aria-label="Access {title}">'
            f'<option value="">Choose access…</option>'
            f'{options}'
            f'</select>'
        )

    else:

        access_html = (
            '<span class="cw-catalog-unavailable">'
            'Not available'
            '</span>'
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Expandable description and metadata
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    details = []

    if description:
        details.append(f"<p>{description}</p>")

    metadata = [
        ("Dates", dates),
        ("Resolution", resolution),
        ("Sensor", safe(field(item, "sensor_type"))),
        ("Region", safe(field(item, "region"))),
        ("Composite", composite),
    ]

    meta_html = "".join(
        f"<span><strong>{label}:</strong> {value}</span>"
        for label, value in metadata
        if value
    )

    if meta_html:
        details.append(
            f'<div class="cw-catalog-metadata">'
            f'{meta_html}'
            f'</div>'
        )

    detail_html = (
        "".join(details)
        if details
        else "No description available."
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------
    # Main row + expandable detail row
    # ------------------------------------------------------

    rows.append(
        f"""
<tr class="cw-catalog-data-row" {data_attrs}>
  <td>
    <button
      type="button"
      class="cw-catalog-toggle"
      aria-expanded="false"
      aria-controls="catalog-detail-{i}"
    >
      {title}
      <span aria-hidden="true" class="cw-catalog-chevron">⌄</span>
    </button>
  </td>
  <td>
    <span class="cw-catalog-product">{product}</span>
  </td>
  <td>
    {access_html}
  </td>
</tr>

<tr
  class="cw-catalog-detail-row"
  id="catalog-detail-{i}"
  hidden
>
  <td colspan="3">
    <div class="cw-catalog-detail-content">
      {detail_html}
    </div>
  </td>
</tr>
"""
    )

display(HTML("\n".join(rows)))
```

:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const rows = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll("#catalogTable .cw-catalog-data-row")
  );

  const selects = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll("#catalogFilters select")
  );

  const wrappers = Array.from(
    document.querySelectorAll("#catalogFilters .cw-catalog-filter")
  );

  const search = document.getElementById("catalogSearch");
  const count = document.getElementById("catalogCount");
  const empty = document.getElementById("catalogEmpty");
  const reset = document.getElementById("catalogReset");

  // --------------------------------------------------------
  // Populate filter options from the YAML-backed table
  // --------------------------------------------------------

  selects.forEach(select => {

    const key = select.dataset.field;

    const values = [
      ...new Set(
        rows
          .map(row => (row.dataset[key] || "").trim())
          .filter(Boolean)
      )
    ].sort((a, b) =>
      a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" })
    );

    values.forEach(value => {
      select.add(new Option(value, value));
    });

  });

  // --------------------------------------------------------
  // Apply all active filters
  // --------------------------------------------------------

  function update() {

    const term = search.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    let visibleCount = 0;

    rows.forEach(row => {

      const detail = row.nextElementSibling;

      const matchesFilters = selects.every(select =>
        !select.value ||
        (row.dataset[select.dataset.field] || "").trim() === select.value
      );

      const text = [
        row.cells[0].textContent,
        row.dataset.product,
        detail?.textContent || ""
      ].join(" ").toLocaleLowerCase();

      const visible =
        matchesFilters &&
        (!term || text.includes(term));

      row.hidden = !visible;

      if (!visible && detail) {
        detail.hidden = true;

        row.querySelector(".cw-catalog-toggle")
          ?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      if (visible) {
        visibleCount++;
      }

    });

    count.textContent =
      `${visibleCount} of ${rows.length} datasets`;

    empty.hidden = visibleCount !== 0;
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------
  // Progressive filter steps
  // --------------------------------------------------------

  function updateSteps(changedIndex = -1) {

    if (
      changedIndex >= 0 &&
      !selects[changedIndex].value
    ) {
      for (
        let i = changedIndex + 1;
        i < selects.length;
        i++
      ) {
        selects[i].value = "";
      }
    }

    wrappers.forEach((wrapper, index) => {
      wrapper.hidden =
        index > 0 && !selects[index - 1].value;
    });

  }

  selects.forEach((select, index) => {

    select.addEventListener("change", () => {
      updateSteps(index);
      update();
    });

  });

  // --------------------------------------------------------
  // Search box
  // --------------------------------------------------------

  search.addEventListener("input", update);

  // --------------------------------------------------------
  // Reset filters
  // --------------------------------------------------------

  reset.addEventListener("click", () => {

    selects.forEach(select => {
      select.value = "";
    });

    search.value = "";

    updateSteps();
    update();

  });

  // --------------------------------------------------------
  // Expand and collapse dataset details
  // --------------------------------------------------------

  rows.forEach(row => {

    const toggle = row.querySelector(".cw-catalog-toggle");
    const detail = row.nextElementSibling;

    toggle?.addEventListener("click", () => {

      const expanding = detail.hidden;

      detail.hidden = !expanding;

      toggle.setAttribute(
        "aria-expanded",
        String(expanding)
      );

    });

  });

  // --------------------------------------------------------
  // Open ERDDAP links
  // --------------------------------------------------------

  document
    .querySelectorAll(".cw-catalog-access-dropdown")
    .forEach(select => {

      select.addEventListener("change", () => {

        if (select.value) {

          window.open(
            select.value,
            "_blank",
            "noopener,noreferrer"
          );

          select.value = "";
        }

      });

    });

  // Initialize
  updateSteps();
  update();

});
</script>
